name: Cut on an action
short_description: Cut on an action once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can cut on an action in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Cut on an action means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Cut on an action in a fresh real-life scenario.
